motion_rule: he rides a checkout belt racing at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the shelves tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; he drives on all fours and never plants himself over the tray; head half the frame; new shot size each beat; camera move every beat
character: a lanky chameleon in a grey shop apron, swivel eyes, deadpan, skin ripping to a new colour every beat
second_characters: A SWARM of identical fat green crickets in his tray, springing out over his head one after another and never caught
props: ONE paper tray riding the belt under his chest, heaped with the identical crickets; ONE steel sledgehammer
prop_continuity: the crickets keep the same green and size, only their number drops; his tongue comes back whole after every fire until 8.6
environment: a narrow supermarket aisle, shelves of jars to the ceiling both sides, the belt racing under him
light_events: hard noon sun bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA-yu, BYS-tre-e, in-FLYA-tsi-ya, me-NYA-et, STO-i-most, e-DY, AJ
audio.pacing: 0.4-2.2, 2.9-4.5, 5.3-7.7 three breaths, every gap under one second, no voice sound outside the lines, each line said once; the yelp at 8.6 is the last voice
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the belt humming, jars rattling, a wet snap each tongue fire, crickets drumming off the tray rim, a steel clang at 8.6

timeline.a: tight on his tongue firing into the lens and snapping back bare, crickets boiling in the tray
he hurls himself down the belt at the lens on all fours, orange ripping to blue
three crickets spring out over his head and he snaps at them and misses
his tongue whips the length of the aisle after them and comes back bare
he drives at the lens over the tray, violet ripping across him
half the heap bails over the tray rim at once and rains past his ear
he lunges the tray to his jaws and the crickets in it spring clear of his teeth
he charges down the racing belt at the lens, yellow ripping to red
his tongue fires at two of them at once and they duck it together
he drives at the lens over the tray, front feet slamming the belt
the last two spring off over his head and his tongue shoots out down the belt after them and stays out, stretched flat past the tray
close on the last cricket: it steps onto the stretched tongue, winks into the lens and hauls a sledgehammer out of its chest
the hammer comes down square on the stretched-out tongue and flattens it against the belt
he rips the flattened tongue back into his mouth in one snap, still driving at the lens
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the cricket riding the tray past his ear with the hammer

must_appear: from 7.7 his tongue is out and stretched flat down the belt in full view; at 8.6 the hammer lands square on that stretched tongue, clear of his mouth, and flattens it; at 9.4 his deadpan face is in the lens
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a cricket caught on the tongue, the hammer landing in his mouth, the hammer landing on his head, the tongue back in his mouth when the hammer lands, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, a word not in the lines, a line said twice, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
